resources.string: Colours help identify groups. The selected structure stays turquoise.
Cartilage colours: purple discs, blue costal structures, green nasal cartilages, amber laryngeal cartilages, pink menisci.
Close the card and clear selection
Combine layers freely. Hide muscles to examine internal organs. Region filters apply to every selected layer; organ systems can be filtered below.
Combine any regions. To see just the head and spine, clear all, then check those two regions.
Choose layers, regions and organ systems, or use Show all to restore hidden structures.
Tap a structure to identify it. Tap the background or close its card to clear the selection.
Double-tap after selecting a structure to centre and zoom in on it.
Left and right always refer to the person being viewed.
Interactive anatomy model. Tap a structure to identify it. Use Layers to combine regions and systems, or Find a structure to search.
